pick.name: Official LSP plugins: typescript-lsp + pyright-lsp (+rust-analyzer-lsp, kotlin-lsp when needed)
pick.what: Diagnostics after every edit + read-only LSP navigation tool
pick.why: Catches type errors Claude introduces before build; Anthropic-maintained; no MCP context cost
pick.install: npm i -g typescript-language-server typescript pyright; /plugin install typescript-lsp@claude-plugins-official; /plugin install pyright-lsp@claude-plugins-official

alts.name: Serena (oraios)
alts.what: LSP-backed MCP with symbol-level edits (rename, replace body, find refs)
alts.why: Adds symbol editing the LSP tool lacks; useful on large codebases

candidates.name: Serena
candidates.verdict: runner-up; keep only if you use its edit tools after LSP plugins land

candidates.name: claude-context (Zilliz)
candidates.verdict: semantic code search; needs embedding API + vector DB

decision: Post-edit diagnostics are the biggest quality win and only the LSP plugins give them. Re-check Serena after a week: drop it if Claude never calls its symbol-edit tools.

verify.note: typescript-lsp and pyright-lsp present in official marketplace.
